titolo: Swarms, Flocks, Gangs: How to build, train, and evaluate multi-agent systems
descr: The new blog series explores building, training and evaluating small, affordable agent swarms on Hugging Face Jobs.
paragrafi: Hugging Face released the first post of a series on multi‑agent systems, focusing on swarms, flocks and gangs.
Running the demo costs roughly $50, showing that modest hardware can support small‑scale swarms.
The post discusses the challenges of multi‑agent reinforcement learning, including credit assignment and communication as part of the policy.
It compares independent versus communicating agents under equal token budgets, asking whether cooperation truly improves performance or merely adds compute cost.
perche: The series offers a reproducible way for researchers and hobbyists to experiment with swarms without large clusters.
